description: Retrieval judgments for the OsiPress corpus. Combines the hand-written 2.0.0 queries (judged_by: human) with short, realistic queries seeded from topically diverse articles, deduplicated by embedding similarity, pooled across lexical, semantic and BM25 retrieval, and graded by an LLM judge (judged_by: llm). Grade 3 = directly answers or is centrally about the query; 2 = substantially covers the topic from another angle; 1 = related context; 0 = a HARD NEGATIVE, retrieved by some method but judged irrelevant. Queries relevant to more than 7% of the corpus were dropped as non-discriminative. Recall is measured against the judged pool, not the full corpus, so the pool must be rebuilt when a materially different backend is introduced. For the same reason false_positive_rate is recorded but must NOT gate a backend that did not contribute to the pool.
